svg.title: Susa and the Persian Empire in Esther
svg.desc: Susa and the Persian Empire in Esther. Geographic orientation map with land, water, coastlines, rivers, and these places: Susa, known location; Jerusalem, known location; Babylon, known location; Indus region, approximate area. This map shows the broad reach described by Esther. The book alone does not let us draw all 127 provinces with precise borders.

text.tspan: Susa and the Persian Empire in Esther
This map shows the broad reach described by Esther. The book alone does not let us draw all 127 provinces
Modern coastlines and rivers are shown for orientation; no unrecorded route or ancient border is claimed.
